attributes.personal_statement: Experienced software developer specializing in Generative AI, adept at optimizing Language Models (LLMs) for advanced data processing and decision-making applications. Skilled in Node.js, Python, Java, JavaScript, and Scrum. Proven track record in backend development, passionate about leveraging NLP advancements to drive impactful business outcomes. projects.name: projects

attributes.summary:
Developed a Redash chat add-on to enable natural language queries for extracting insights from dashboards and connected databases, transforming complex SQL queries into actionable insights for team members without technical backgrounds.

July 24, 2024 – July 31, 2024

The project improves Language Models (LLMs) by automating the creation, testing, and ranking of prompts using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). It makes prompt creation easier, ensures they work well through thorough testing, and ranks them for the best results. This helps in making better decisions, working more efficiently, and improving customer experience.
The project enhances NLP for the Amharic language by collecting and processing high-quality data, developing APIs for seamless integration, and advanced NLP tools for African languages.

attributes.role: Data engineering, Machine learning and Generative AI Trainee
attributes.summary:
Developed an LLM-based Redash chatbot add-on to enhance data analytics, visualization, and automated insight extraction, enabling natural language queries to generate SQL and visualizations from YouTube data sources using Python,  OpenAI API and LangChain.
Enhanced business interaction with Language Models (LLMs) by creating AI-driven solutions for Automatic Prompt Generation, Evaluation Data Generation, and Prompt Testing, improving decision-making and operational efficiency.
Designed and implemented a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for Contract Q&A, enhancing contract analysis by integrating advanced NLP techniques and evaluating system performance, resulting in improved accuracy and contextual relevance of legal responses.
Worked on a project focused on fine-tuning open-source LLM models for multilingual customer support, optimizing text embedding and generation in Amharic to enhance AI-driven responses and engagement.
Developed dashboard using Streamlit  for evaluating TellCo, analyzed data, and performed user segmentation, which helped inform the investor’s decision to purchase the company.
Built and managed a scalable data warehouse using PostgreSQL, orchestrated workflows with Airflow, implemented ELT processes with dbt, and created data visualizations in Redash for a city traffic department, enhancing data processing efficiency and actionable insights.
Collaborated in implementing a scalable backtesting infrastructure for crypto trading using  Apache Kafka and MLflow resulting in an automated data pipeline and optimized backtesting framework for a crypto startup’s trading platform.
Enhanced software applications by implementing new functionalities and resolving software issues, resulting in improved user experience and smoother operation.

Translated project requirements into technical specifications, designed system architecture with workflow diagrams, and integrated frontend and backend functionalities using RESTful APIs. Collaborated with the QA team to ensure product quality and provided customer support to address user inquiries and resolve technical issues.

Developed mobile applications using the Flutter framework. Collaborated with UI/UX designers and product managers to deliver cohesive and feature-rich applications. Integrated AWS Cognito for secure user authentication and authorization.
